adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to documented GET /account/me. Create/send/archive writes are omitted.
Native category is productivity (source Productivity/Communication; Communication is not in the Rust CATEGORIES allowlist).

Official docs recommend a User-Agent and Content-Type on every request; native omits the upstream user-agent and sends Content-Type only when a JSON body is present. These GETs send Accept plus Token token= auth.
Maps to documented GET /account/me. Returns raw JSON:API under AppCall data.
Optional page and per bind to documented pagination query names. Official query/email filters are omitted from this bounded subset.
Client ID is a URL-encoded path segment on GET /clients/{id}.
Optional page, per, status, archived, and recipient_email bind to documented query names.
recipient_emails array is omitted because native query templates cannot comma-join an array the way the pinned source does; official docs also accept comma-separated values on recipient_email.
Optional page, per, and public_templates bind to documented query names on GET /templates.
